identity.name: Axiom Hotel
identity.one_line_description: Axiom Hotel is a boutique business hotel that fuses the clarity of an AI-era workspace with the warmth of curated hospitality, designed for the modern professional.
identity.target_audience: Business travelers, tech executives, and innovation-driven professionals who expect seamless productivity, thoughtful design, and a stay that feels as sharp as their work.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Immediately communicate Axiom Hotel's identity as a precision-engineered boutique business hotel and guide visitors toward exploring accommodations or making contact.
pages.meta_description: Axiom Hotel — a boutique business hotel built for the modern professional. Precision comfort, intelligent spaces, and seamless stays in the heart of the city.

sections.intent: Establish the brand's core promise and draw the visitor into the Axiom world with a bold, intelligent first impression.
sections.headline: Where Every Stay Is Engineered for Excellence
sections.subheadline: A boutique business hotel designed with the precision of the future and the warmth of true hospitality.

sections.intent: Highlight the three core pillars of the Axiom experience to quickly orient the visitor on what makes this hotel distinct.
sections.headline: Built for the Way You Work and Rest

items.title: Intelligent Workspaces
items.description: Every room and suite is configured as a high-performance environment — ergonomic setups, ultra-fast connectivity, and distraction-free acoustics.

items.title: Curated Calm
items.description: Thoughtfully designed interiors that balance focused energy with restorative stillness, so you arrive sharp and leave recharged.

items.title: Frictionless Service
items.description: From seamless digital check-in to 24-hour concierge intelligence, every interaction is designed to remove friction from your day.

sections.intent: Convert engaged visitors into bookers or inquiry leads before they leave the homepage.
sections.headline: Your Next Stay Starts Here
sections.subheadline: Explore tailored packages, premium rooms, and exclusive offers crafted for business travelers.

pages.title: Accommodations
pages.goal: Present each room and suite category with enough detail and clarity that a visitor can confidently select the right accommodation for their needs.
pages.meta_description: Discover Axiom Hotel's range of intelligently designed rooms and suites — built for business travelers who demand precision, comfort, and connectivity.

sections.intent: Set the tone for the accommodations section and frame the rooms as precision-crafted environments rather than standard hotel offerings.
sections.headline: Rooms Designed Like Systems. Felt Like Home.
sections.subheadline: Each space at Axiom is calibrated for focus, rest, and everything in between.

sections.intent: Showcase all room categories with concise, benefit-led descriptions so visitors can compare and choose the right fit.
sections.headline: Find Your Optimal Configuration

items.title: Signal Room
items.description: Our entry-level smart room. Compact, connected, and precisely outfitted with a standing desk, 4K display, and blackout acoustics for the focused solo traveler.

items.title: Logic Suite
items.description: A spacious suite with a dedicated work lounge, dual-monitor docking station, and a separate rest zone engineered for deep recovery sleep.

items.title: Executive Node
items.description: Designed for senior professionals. Includes a private meeting alcove, premium ergonomic seating, and a curated minibar stocked with brain-performance essentials.

items.title: Apex Penthouse
items.description: The pinnacle of the Axiom experience. A full-floor suite with a panoramic city view, private boardroom, and a dedicated 24-hour concierge line.

sections.intent: Reinforce the value of every room by listing the standard amenities and technology features that come with every Axiom stay.
sections.headline: Every Room Comes Fully Loaded

items.title: Ultra-High-Speed Fiber
items.description: Symmetrical 10 Gbps connectivity available in every room, with zero throttling and enterprise-grade uptime guarantees.

items.title: Smart Climate Control
items.description: AI-assisted temperature and air quality management that learns your preferences within hours of check-in.

items.title: Acoustic Engineering
items.description: Triple-glazed windows and sound-dampening wall panels ensure a silent environment whether you're on a call or asleep.

pages.title: Offers
pages.goal: Present curated packages and exclusive rates that motivate business travelers to commit to a booking by communicating clear, high-value propositions.
pages.meta_description: Explore Axiom Hotel's exclusive packages and offers — from extended stay rates to corporate partnerships crafted for business travelers.

sections.intent: Frame the offers page as a destination for smart value rather than generic discounts, consistent with the intelligent brand voice.
sections.headline: Optimized Rates for the Way You Travel
sections.subheadline: Tailored packages built around how modern professionals actually use their time.

sections.intent: Display the core offer packages with clear benefits and pricing signals so visitors can quickly identify the best fit.
sections.headline: Choose Your Configuration

items.title: Sprint Stay
items.description: Perfect for the 1–3 night focused trip. Includes complimentary high-speed breakfast, same-day laundry, and early check-in when available.

items.title: Deep Work Week
items.description: Seven nights engineered for productivity. Includes a dedicated co-working desk, daily in-room catering credits, and a weekly strategy concierge session.

items.title: Corporate Alliance
items.description: A custom rate agreement for companies sending five or more travelers per quarter. Includes priority booking, invoicing, and a dedicated account manager.

sections.intent: Create urgency and drive direct bookings by highlighting a limited-time or seasonal promotion.
sections.headline: Q3 Early Access: 20% Off Logic Suites
sections.subheadline: Book any Logic Suite stay of three nights or more before the end of the month and lock in our best rate of the quarter.

pages.title: Journal
pages.goal: Build authority and brand affinity by publishing thoughtful, intelligent content relevant to business travelers — reinforcing Axiom's identity as a forward-thinking destination.
pages.meta_description: The Axiom Journal — insights, perspectives, and stories for the modern business traveler. Productivity, travel intelligence, and the future of work on the road.

sections.intent: Introduce the journal as an editorial space with a distinct voice that reflects Axiom's intelligent, forward-thinking brand.
sections.headline: Dispatches from the Edge of How We Work
sections.subheadline: Perspectives on productivity, travel, and the evolving art of doing business anywhere.

sections.intent: Showcase a curated selection of recent journal entries to demonstrate the depth and relevance of Axiom's editorial voice.
sections.headline: What We're Thinking About

items.title: The Science of the Perfect Work Hotel Room
items.description: We break down the environmental variables — light, acoustics, temperature, and layout — that separate a productive stay from a forgettable one.

items.title: Why Your Wi-Fi Speed Is a Business Decision
items.description: Slow hotel internet isn't just annoying — it's a measurable drag on output. Here's what to look for and why Axiom built its network differently.

items.title: The Rise of the Micro-Headquarters
items.description: More executives are using boutique hotels as temporary command centers. We explore the trend and what it means for how companies think about travel.

sections.intent: Convert journal readers into hotel guests by bridging the editorial experience back to the core product.
sections.headline: Experience Axiom for Yourself
sections.subheadline: The ideas in this journal are built into every room, every service, and every detail of your stay.

pages.title: Contact
pages.goal: Give visitors a clear, low-friction way to make a booking inquiry, request corporate rates, or reach the concierge team — closing the conversion loop.
pages.meta_description: Contact Axiom Hotel to book a stay, request corporate rates, or connect with our concierge team. We respond within one business hour.

sections.intent: Set a confident, welcoming tone for the contact page that reflects Axiom's promise of frictionless service.
sections.headline: We're Ready When You Are
sections.subheadline: Whether you're booking for yourself or your entire team, our concierge team responds within one business hour.

sections.intent: Provide all contact channels and a structured inquiry form so visitors can reach Axiom through their preferred method.
sections.headline: Start Your Inquiry
sections.body: Fill in your details below and a member of our concierge team will respond within one business hour. For urgent requests, call us directly or use our live chat.

items.title: Reservations
items.description: For room bookings, package inquiries, and availability checks.

items.title: Corporate Accounts
items.description: For companies seeking Alliance rates, invoicing, or multi-traveler agreements.

items.title: Concierge
items.description: For in-stay requests, special arrangements, or anything else your stay requires.

sections.intent: Help visitors locate the hotel and understand its proximity to key business districts, transport hubs, and landmarks.
sections.headline: Positioned at the Center of Everything
sections.subheadline: Located in the financial district, Axiom Hotel is minutes from the convention center, major transit lines, and the city's top corporate campuses.

items.title: Address
items.description: 14 Meridian Plaza, Financial District, New York, NY 10004

items.title: Nearest Transit
items.description: 2 minutes walk to Fulton Street Station (A, C, J, Z, 2, 3, 4, 5 lines). Direct AirTrain connection to JFK available.

items.title: Parking
items.description: Valet parking available 24 hours. Self-park garage on Meridian Lane with validated rates for Axiom guests.
